title: My English Book 5
header: Builds "My English Book 5" – fifth-grade English syllabus – A4 portrait.

noteP: هٰذَا الكِتَابُ يُكْمِلُ تَعْلِيمَ الإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ: الرُّوتِينُ اليَوْمِيُّ، وَالخُطَطُ المُسْتَقْبَلِيَّةُ بِـ going to، وَصِيغَةُ التَّفْضِيلِ، وَالمَعْدُودُ وَغَيْرُ المَعْدُودِ، وَقَوَاعِدُ المَدْرَسَةِ، وَالأَمَاكِنُ، مَعَ قِصَّتَيْنِ 🇬🇧
noteLi: اطْلُبُوا مِنْ طِفْلِكُمْ أَنْ يَصِفَ يَوْمَهُ بِالإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ.
اسْأَلُوهُ عَنْ خُطَطِهِ لِلْعُطْلَةِ: What are you going to do?
قَارِنُوا ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْيَاءَ فِي البَيْتِ: the biggest / the smallest.
الكِتَابُ يُقْرَأُ مِنَ اليَسَارِ إِلَى اليَمِينِ.
blurb: A complete, colourful 3D English book – part 5, with Arabic meanings for every word.
blurbLi: My daily routine and telling the time
Future plans with “going to” and superlatives (-est)
Countable and uncountable food, and school rules with must
Places in town and two short stories

units.title: My Daily Routine
units.intro: We use the simple present to talk about our daily routine.
items: I wake up at six o'clock.
I have breakfast with my family.
I go to school by bus.
I do my homework after lunch.

acts.title: Always or never?
rows: Good students ... listen to the teacher.
We ... throw rubbish on the street.

units.title: Plans: going to
units.intro: We use “going to” for future plans: I am going to visit my grandma.
items: We are going to travel to Makkah next month.
I am going to visit my grandma on Friday.
They are going to play football tomorrow.
She is going to read a new book tonight.

units.title: The Biggest!
units.intro: We add -est to compare three or more things: big → the biggest.
items: The whale is the biggest animal.
The racing car is the fastest.
The ant is the smallest here.
This tree is the tallest in the park.

units.title: Food: some & any
units.intro: We can count apples and eggs, but we cannot count water and rice.
items: There are some eggs in the fridge.
There is some water in the glass.
Is there any rice? Yes, there is.

units.title: School Rules
units.intro: We use “must” for rules and “mustn't” for things we must not do.
items: We must listen to the teacher.
We must be on time for school.
We mustn't run in the classroom.
We mustn't shout at our friends.

units.title: In My Town
units.intro: Places in town and where they are.
items: The hospital is next to the park.
The library is opposite the school.
The bakery is between the bank and the mosque.

units.title: Reading Time
units.intro: Read the stories and answer the questions.

acts.title: A Trip to Makkah
acts.html:
A Trip to Makkah 🕋

Last summer, Ahmed went to Makkah with his family.
They travelled by plane.
Ahmed saw the Kaaba for the first time.
He prayed and made dua for his parents.
It was the best trip of his life!

acts.title: Answer
rows: When did Ahmed go to Makkah?
Who did he make dua for?

acts.title: The Clever Crow
acts.html:
The Clever Crow 🐦

A thirsty crow found a jug with a little water.
He could not reach the water.
He dropped small stones into the jug, one by one.
The water rose to the top.
The crow drank and flew away happily.

acts.title: Answer
rows: What did he drop into the jug?
